dialogue.speaker: Álvaro
dialogue.spanish: ¡Corre, Elena, tía, que el control de equipaje del AVE a Valencia cierra en tres minutos!
dialogue.english: Run, Elena, girl, the baggage check for the high-speed train to Valencia closes in three minutes!

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.spanish: ¡Madre mía, qué agobio! Pues es que el autobús venía a tope por el atasco en el paseo de la Castellana.
dialogue.english: Oh my goodness, how stressful! Well the bus was packed to the gills because of the traffic jam on La Castellana.

slang.actualMeaning: packed full / to the max (very common in Spain)
slang.example: El vagón del metro iba a tope a las ocho de la mañana.

dialogue.speaker: Álvaro
dialogue.spanish: Bueno, pasa tú primero la maleta por el escáner mientras yo enseño los billetes en el móvil.
dialogue.english: Well, put your suitcase through the scanner first while I show the tickets on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.spanish: Vale, ya pasamos. O sea, ¿en qué vía está estacionado nuestro tren?
dialogue.english: Okay, we're through. I mean, which platform is our train parked on?

dialogue.speaker: Álvaro
dialogue.spanish: Vía cuatro, hemos entrado por los pelos... Mira, somos el coche número tres, asientos de ventanilla.
dialogue.english: Platform four, we made it by the skin of our teeth... Look, we're car number three, window seats.

slang.actualMeaning: by the skin of one's teeth / just barely in time
slang.example: Llegamos al embarque del avión por los pelos.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.spanish: ¡Uf, qué alivio! En cuanto arranque el tren me pido un café en la cafetería y me echo una siesta.
dialogue.english: Phew, what a relief! As soon as the train pulls out I'm ordering a coffee in the café car and taking a nap.

questions.question: Why were Álvaro and Elena almost late for their high-speed train ('el AVE')?
options: Their bus was packed and stuck in a traffic jam on La Castellana
They went to the wrong train station in Madrid
questions.explanation: Elena says: 'el autobús venía a tope por el atasco en el paseo de la Castellana.'

questions.question: Which platform and train car do they board, and what city are they traveling to?
options: Platform 4, Car 3, window seats, heading to Valencia
Platform 1, Car 1, aisle seats, heading to Barcelona
Platform 7, Car 5, dining car, heading to Seville
Platform 2, Car 2, window seats, heading to Toledo
questions.explanation: Álvaro says the train to Valencia is on 'Vía cuatro... coche número tres, asientos de ventanilla.'

questions.question: How much time was left before baggage security closed when they arrived?
questions.explanation: Álvaro shouts: 'el control de equipaje del AVE a Valencia cierra en tres minutos!'

questions.question: Slang Side Quest: In Spain, what do 'venir a tope' and 'por los pelos' mean?
options: 'A tope' = packed full / to the max; 'por los pelos' = by the skin of our teeth / just barely
'A tope' = very slowly; 'por los pelos' = without luggage
'A tope' = empty; 'por los pelos' = with messy hair
'A tope' = broken down; 'por los pelos' = way too early
questions.explanation: 'A tope' means packed full / at maximum capacity, and 'por los pelos' means just barely / by a hair!
